description: ARRAY_CONSTRUCT_COMPACT(val1, ...) is ARRAY_CONSTRUCT with every SQL NULL argument omitted, so the result is shorter than its argument list, an all-NULL call and a no-argument call both give the empty array, a nested array is embedded rather than stringified, and it works over table columns. A VARIANT JSON null is a value, not a SQL NULL, so it survives. The contrast is live-verified: a SQL NULL array ELEMENT is the VARIANT undefined - ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, NULL, 2) renders [1,undefined,2] - while ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, PARSE_JSON('null'), 2) keeps [1,null,2]. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayConstructCompactTest (now retired); the array cells are read through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell.
